document: Form PENS.E/2-B - Payment Instructions for Survivors' Benefits
governing_article: Articles 34, 35 bis, 35 ter, 36, 37 of the UNJSPF Regulations

chunks.heading: What form PENS.E/2-B is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/2-B requests payment of a survivors' benefit. It has 8 sections across 3 pages and must be dated and hand-signed on every page.

chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.E/2-B
chunks.text: Section 1 - Deceased participant or retiree information; Section 2 - Survivor information; Section 3 - Appointed legal guardian information (if applicable); Section 4 - Type of benefit(s) due (select one or more: surviving spouse's benefit art.34, divorced surviving spouse's benefit art.35bis, spouse married after separation art.35ter, child's benefit art.36, secondary dependant's benefit art.37); Section 5 - Bank account information; Section 6 - Emergency contact; Section 7 - Acknowledgement and signature; Section 8 - Signature authentication.

chunks.heading: Documents the survivor must enclose
chunks.text: A copy of a valid government-issued photo ID showing full name, date of birth and scripted signature, and a recently dated bank statement/bank document or voided cheque showing all banking information, plus any other documents listed in the form's instructions.

chunks.heading: Signature authentication section on the form
chunks.text: Section 8 requires a UN official, government official, or notary public to certify in person that the survivor (identified in Section 2 or 3) signed the form in their presence, including their printed name, title/licence/index number, email, signature, and official stamp/seal.
